Historical citation network: included papers and their references
Focus view: all 45 included papers + the 25 most frequently cited external references | 199 direct links shown
Complete reconstructed network: 1,924 nodes and 2,237 links; cited-reference years 1947–2026
Blue diamonds: included papers (review IDs). Gold circles: cited references; circle area increases with the number of included papers citing the work.
Arrows run from citing paper to cited work. Gold links highlight the 2017 reference “Attention is all you need”. Vertical placement is for readability.

The complete network and reference evidence are supplied separately. No citation links among external references were inferred. Five source-paper year conflicts and undated references remain in the audit.
